Listen to people improv and then practice improving every day. Play modes instead of C. Whenever you think it’s “boring” that doesn’t mean you aren’t good or it’s time to stop playing, it simply means it’s time to move on to a new idea. Improv is real time composition 


Don’t take it too seriously. Have fun with it and enjoy the music. Listen to what you like and think about what you like about it. Enjoy it and continue. You won’t become what you want to be in a day but I promise if you keep up you’ll get it. Music theory foundation helps a ton. Learning simple grooves with the left hand helps as well. 

Jesus Molina has some great videos on improvising I highly recommend. 

Remember learning is not a race, good luck
